name: Lisboa Games Week
blurb: Portugal's biggest video-game expo, four days of esports, sim racing, VR, board games and a cosplay contest at FIL in Lisbon.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: '4 DIAS DE EVENTO + 40 000 VISITANTES Horários 19 a 22 Novembro 2026 ... FIL- Parque das Nações' and 'Feira Internacional de Lisboa, Rua do Bojador, 1998-010 Lisboa, Portugal'.

notes: LGW is primarily a gaming/esports trade expo (RETAKE | EAFC26 competitions, sim racing, VR/AR, board games) with an open-call cosplay contest rather than a celebrity-guest convention. The homepage teases a 'TALK SHOW EM DIRETO + 20 CONVIDADOS' (live talk show with 20 guests) on the main stage, but no names, photos or a lineup page were found: the 'Programa' nav link 404s (resolves to a dead 2015 image URL) and the Cosplay page is only an open application form for cosplayers to attend free, not a guest/judge list. Guests is therefore none-yet rather than assumed none.
